mechanism_narrative: The slight week-to-week easing in WORKPLACES and stabilization in TRANSIT indicate a mild rebound in daytime foot traffic that will continue to lift RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL remains elevated while WORKPLACES stays depressed, households substitute away from discretionary outings and RETAIL_REC falls within one to two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL stays above 4 points while WORKPLACES stays below -10 points for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 14 days while RESIDENTIAL remains above 4 and WORKPLACES remains below -10 for two straight weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A recovery in TRANSIT from very depressed levels signals fewer access frictions and more downtown circulation, which translates into higher RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT improves by at least 2 points week-on-week after being below -30
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase relative to the last four-week average within 28 days after TRANSIT rises by at least 2 points from below -30.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent weakness in PARKS during the late-summer to early-fall period indicates less leisure spillover and weaker casual shopping trips, pushing RETAIL_REC lower over the next month.
evidence_refs: fact:weekly PARKS values remain around -34 to -38 across the snapshot
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days while PARKS remains below -30 throughout the period.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM stays positive while RETAIL_REC remains negative, routine errand traffic is shifting toward necessity trips rather than discretionary shopping, so RETAIL_REC will remain weak over the next one to two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM is above 0 while RETAIL_REC is below -8 for three consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC moves above its last-four-week mean within 7 days while GROCERY_PHARM stays positive and RETAIL_REC stays below -8.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained narrowing of the gap between WORKPLACES and RESIDENTIAL implies more mixed daily movement patterns that support spontaneous retail visits, causing RETAIL_REC to rise over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: the WORKPLACES minus RESIDENTIAL gap narrows by at least 5 points over two weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to rise over the next 28 days after the WORKPLACES-RESIDENTIAL gap narrows by at least 5 points.

mechanism_narrative: In a tightening-restriction regime, further declines in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES suppress discretionary travel chains and pull RETAIL_REC down within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both fall week-on-week after already being below -30 and -10 respectively
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within 14 days after both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES post another weekly drop from already depressed levels.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS remain deeply negative while GROCERY_PHARM stays near flat, the mobility mix favors indoor utilitarian trips over leisure, and retail-and-recreation mobility will edge lower over the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days while PARKS stays below -30 and GROCERY_PHARM remains between 0 and 2.
